subject: R and rmr in Hadoop Distributed Cache?

messages.author: 8576b908fe3b19dd
messages.subject: R and rmr in Hadoop Distributed Cache?
parts:
I'm looking into a proof of concept using R and rmr with Hadoop.  I was asked by the sysadmin if it is possible to put the R and rmr libraries in distributed cache instead of installing it on every node.

Does anyone know if this is possible?  If so, any documentation you can point me to?

Thanks,

Bill

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: R and rmr in Hadoop Distributed Cache?
parts:
Check out the branch 0-install. The problem with that branch is that it needs to create an archive of an R build for a specific location (the prefix option to ./configure). R builds, contrary to what has been stated, are not relocatable. There is a script in the package source under tools/0-install that will create the archive you need but right now it is specific to debian type linux distros and tested only on amazon ec2 ubuntu. Anyone with a little scripting and a little sysadmin skills should be able to adapt it to your needs and I would love to hear how it went and get the changes back as pull requests if possible. The plan is to have a few people expand and test this process to a number of OSes and when it is solid enough promote it to be the main deploy strategy, and make installing everywhere optional or obsolete. 


Antonio
